tagline: Toronto parking revenue lost to snowstorms, 2023-2025

anchor.source: Toronto Parking Authority 2026 Operating Budget report, Nov 25 2025, p.1

calibration.math: 371,000 disclosed transactions / 41.9 cm episode snowfall = 8,854 transactions per cm
calibration.dollars_per_transaction_source: TPA 2025 forecast: $177.3M revenue on 32.4M transactions, blended rate 5.47 per transaction
calibration.note: The +-30% band on the rate contains the alternative reading where the 371,000 covers only the larger Feb 12-18 wave (rate would be 11,380 per cm).

event_definition: A snow day is >= 1.0 cm. An event is a maximal run of snow days allowing one gap day below 1.0 cm. A major storm qualifies at >= 5.0 cm total.
snowfall_source: Open-Meteo archive (ERA5 reanalysis), Toronto 43.65N 79.38W, daily snowfall_sum. Environment Canada bulk downloads were unreachable from the build network; Open-Meteo is the documented fallback.
ticket_cross_check: Daily City of Toronto parking ticket counts, 2023-2025, are used as a street parking activity proxy only, never as a revenue input.
